extension.documentation:
Synchronous listener on the check-in pair, both fired on the *live* document.
aboutToCheckIn records which version is the current last one, just before the new one is created. documentCheckedIn receives the new version through its checkedInVersionRef property and compares the two. Capturing the previous version before the fact is what removes any need to guess it afterwards from the version numbering.
Ordinary saves, versions and proxies are ignored. The listener name is the one to pass to EventServiceAdmin#setListenerEnabledFlag to mute the feature instance-wide.

Synchronous guard keeping every BlobDiff under /change-diff, and everything under /change-diff inside it. The core does not enforce allowed subtypes, so without it any user could create a BlobDiff elsewhere with fabricated content. Never disable it on a live instance.
